Uses and Administration Sparfloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibacterial with actions and uses similar to those of ciprofloxacin (p.247). It is given orally for the treatment of susceptible infections in a usual dose of 100 to 300 mg in 1 or 2 divided doses daily. It has also been tried in tuberculosis (see under Uses and Administration of Cipro- floxacin, p.248). ◊ General references. 1. Finch RG, et al., eds. Sparfloxacin: focus on clinical perform- ance.
